about_the_game:
[Game Background]

This is Birmingham, England, 1939. In this game, you'll play as a lady seeking vengeance for her deceased gangster husband. We are committed to recreating classic scenes of the 1930s British gangland, immersing players in this dark world.

[Key Features]

  • Superior Graphics: From character costumes to meticulously researched scene props, we strive to recreate an authentic 1939 British gangland world.

  • Intense Combat: Fast-paced, visceral combat with impactful feedback. Enemies fall like wheat one moment, and death could come the next.

  • Diverse Weaponry: You'll encounter enemies wielding various weapons, all of which can be acquired and used. Both melee and ranged weapons are carefully designed with unique characteristics.

  • Rich Strategy: Various level designs and enemy AI behaviours allow for multiple approaches to tackle each challenge.

"When the bullet of vengeance is chambered, the whole world holds its breath." Do you dare to dance this deadly tango on a tightrope?

content_descriptors.notes: In Cohen 1939, there are some scenes of bloodiness and violence that were characteristic of the mafia at that time.
